2105-4598-5223-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-5223-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-5223-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1445-2279-4871-8250.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-8250.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2645-3257-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3257-3430-5475.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6723-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4518-4742.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-2981-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2981-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1070-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-2034.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

997-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
997-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1018-1987-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1018-1987-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2523-2869-4448.description:
Activate Dimir House Guard by sacrificing it.
When Dimir House Guard dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Dimir House Guard that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Dimir House Guard ability.
Repeat using the Dimir House Guard token

5231-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-3875-4231-5184-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4053-5499-7297--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7297--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

489-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

339-677-5686-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

304-1978-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
304-1978-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Tough Cookie.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2921-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger

24-3417-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-3417-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

2577-2932-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-2932-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4251-4826-5404--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
4251-4826-5404--85.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its second ability and Shaun's first ability.
Resolve the Shaun trigger, creating an attacking copy of Godo that is a nonlegendary Synth artifact in addition to its other types and that enters untapped due to Archelos.
When the Godo token enters, its own first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Godo trigger from step 1, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, each time attacking with a new Godo that has not attacked yet this turn in step 1.

789-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Gutter Grime trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, putting a slime counter on it and creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.
789-4050-6115.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

1486-3459-5929--67.description:
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the crew ability.
Repeat.

1909-4360-4486.notablePrerequisites: Greenweaver Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1909-4360-4486.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Greenweaver Druid.
Repeat.

1636-2703.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
1636-2703.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1656-1993-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-1993-4543.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Budoka Gardener's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

4241-4659-4854-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4241-4659-4854-4871.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing the Treasure to become a 1/1 artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the legendary creature.

1367-3039-3908-4450.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double is a copy of Carth the Lion.
1367-3039-3908-4450.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat.
